target_customer: Product, customer education, training, marketing and IT teams at software companies, including enterprises such as Atlassian and Zendesk per a founder post
problem: Making and updating instructional videos and help documentation is slow and expensive, so product walkthroughs go stale.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription: free tier, Solo from 40 USD per month, Business from 120 USD per month billed annually, custom enterprise

founders.name: Akash Anand
founders.background_notes: No further background on the YC page.

founders.name: Neel Balar
education: IIT Madras, Engineering Design and Data Science
founders.background_notes: Led a student Hyperloop team that raised 1.1M USD from the Indian government and competed at the SpaceX Hyperloop Pod Competition.

founders.name: Prajwal Prakash
founders.background_notes: Co-founded a quantum machine learning group in college.

technical_complexity.rationale: Turning screen recordings into polished videos with AI voiceover, captions and step guides was standard media and ML engineering with some hard parts in editing automation.

defensibility.rationale: Feature set was easy for Scribe, Tango, Guidde, Loom and new AI entrants to copy; enterprise security certifications and stored video libraries add some lock-in over time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added AI features but no acquisition or shutdown of Clueso found; it kept raising through 2026.

market_need_then: Software teams needed product videos and help docs for onboarding and training; the company reports 1M+ videos created in six months and 1000+ organizations, self reported.

branding.name_origin: CEO Akash Anand says the team first considered GigaUser, then chose a detective theme inspired by Inspector Clouseau from The Pink Panther, with wordplay on clue, framed later as clue to solution.

identity.logo: Original detective themed logo, replaced by a puzzle piece identity in 2025
identity.mascot_or_character: Detective theme inspired by Inspector Clouseau
identity.visual_style: Pink as brand hue, a nod to The Pink Panther

branding.brand_signature: Pink Panther inspired detective theme and pink brand color

rebrands.why: Company said the old logo no longer reflected who it was becoming; date varies by source (a brand post is dated 2025-10)

branding.community_and_virality: Company publishes brand story posts; no independent meme or merch coverage found.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive named story and consistent color, backed by company posts, but little independent press on the brand itself.

pivots.from: Turning rough screen recordings into polished videos with AI voiceover
pivots.to: Agentic video platform that plans, records, edits and updates videos
pivots.why: Per a founder post and funding coverage, broadening from voiceover cleanup into agentic video creation; exact date not confirmed

outcome_analysis: Clueso, a Winter 2023 YC company from IIT Madras founders who earlier built Desklamp, raised a 1.4M seed in April 2024 and a 10M Series A led by Dharana Capital in October 2026 with all prior investors returning. Reported near 100 percent enterprise retention and 1000+ customer organizations are company claims. Growth is supported by enterprise security certifications, but competition from Scribe, Guidde, Loom and AI video tools is heavy.
notes: Seed cross-checked by Axios, Inc42 and Venture Intelligence; Series A by Pulse 2.0, Unite.AI, YourStory and Inc42. Total funding reported near 12M. CB Insights lists a Delaware base while YC lists Bengaluru. Competitor search returned only 2025 to 2026 vendor comparison pages, so no competitors dated near the Winter 2023 batch are listed. Founded year 2022 is an estimate from the YC batch; unverified.
